purpose: Masala Short (final): युद्ध से एक दिन पहले माँ ने बताया सच… कर्ण और कुंती 😢 | Mahabharat Emotional Story #shorts

scenes.scene: Wide shot at eye level showing the whole place. Setting: the wide river Ganga at dawn, seen from far away, mist on the water. What happens: Landscape only: the golden sun rising over the wide misty river, small oil lamps floating on the calm water, birds flying low; an empty landscape. Nobody speaks and nobody's lips move; no voices at all. There are no people, no faces and no heads anywhere in this shot, only what is described. Nobody looks into the camera lens: the camera is an invisible observer that nobody notices. Film look: Photorealistic live-action epic Indian historical drama set in ancient India, shot on a cinema camera, golden dawn light, soft mist over the river, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. Upright, normal orientation (never rotated or upside down). Vertical 9:16 frame for a phone screen, the subject in the upper-middle of the picture. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no signboards, no shop signs, no posters, no name plates, no vehicle number plates, no readable letters anywhere.
scenes.sound: Gentle river water, soft temple bells far away, no voices
